turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is this volume all right for you?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, as long as you do not turn away.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not felt right lately, my chest is bothering me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It feels like a heavy weight sitting on my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does the pain spread anywhere, like your arm or jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, it goes down my left arm a little.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How long have you been having it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About three days ago, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sitting quietly makes it better.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I get confused with my pills. I am afraid I will take them wrong.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it comes even when I am sitting.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not fainted.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or clammy when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I do not sweat.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have trouble breathing with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, my breathing is fine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does heart disease run in your family?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me about your health conditions, like smoking, blood pressure, sugar and cholesterol.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high cholesterol. I quit smoking years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any past heart operations or procedures?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have never had any heart procedure.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me your daily medicines?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Atorvastatin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, let me go over the plan. First, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit. Second, come back to this clinic in one week. Third, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Just so I know I explained it clearly, can you tell me in your own words what you will do?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will bring my medicine bottles next time, come back here in a week and get the heart tracing and the blood test today.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any other questions?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I think I understand.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
